headline: Workday Prices $2.5 Billion Senior Notes Offering
summary: Workday announced the pricing of a $2.5 billion senior notes offering to fund general corporate purposes and capital structure management.
why: Workday is a prominent enterprise cloud software provider whose debt issuances are closely watched by fixed-income investors for corporate liquidity metrics.

impacts.name: Workday
impacts.why: Large debt offerings increase fixed interest obligations while securing immediate liquidity for operations.
